youtube_description:
Welcome to Neon Frontier—an AI/ML race visualization where multiple model architectures compete to detect, classify, and predict Marsquakes from noisy sensor data in real time. Watch how each competitor “flies” through crater sectors, how accuracy vs speed plays out, and which team claims the top signal station.

In this episode:
- Live-style race visualization
- Model approaches compared (CNN, RNN, Transformer, GNN, Hybrid, Bayesian)
- Metrics-driven leaderboard swings
- The final winner: best detection + stability under noise

Subscribe for more futuristic ML competitions and data-racing spectacles!
